title: Every Ply: The Sector-Clock Siege
youtubeTitle: Subspace Lattice Academy Ep.6 — Every Ply of the 115-Ply Sector Integration Siege
description: The complete record of Mission 3: dig-in defense, the sector clock arming at ply 100, Contested Space as a stalling weapon, and a win by coverage rather than capture.

scenes.eyebrow: Fleet Academy · Episode 6 · Full annotated game
scenes.headline: Every Ply: The Sector-Clock Siege
scenes.subhead: All 115 plies of Mission 3 — the game the Advanced Manual uses to explain Sector Integration.
scenes.voiceover: Episode six: the long one. One hundred fifteen plies, every move annotated. This is the game where no Hub ever falls and coverage decides it — the reason the sector clock exists.
Full hybrid-fleet rules: Integration Hold, Contested Space, activation at ply one hundred, and the Initiative Relay. Surgical Strike stays legal the whole way; it simply never lands.

scenes.nextEpisode: Practice against the AI · Read the Advanced Manual
scenes.voiceover: White wins by Sector Integration. The clock only matters after activation; Surgical Strike remains the primary hunt until then. When both fleets dig in, coverage and Contested Space stop eternal turtling.
